02 / PHOTOGRAPHY & ART DIRECTION

VANTA FORM

A fashion story about taking up space. Sculptural silhouettes meet the quiet geometry of the city.

CONCEPT · ART DIRECTION · IMAGE MAKING2026SELF-INITIATED CONCEPT

The idea.

The campaign pairs generous tailoring with stark architectural settings. Directional light reveals the structure of each garment, while restrained colour keeps the focus on form, posture and attitude. Portrait and landscape compositions give the story room to move across formats.
